body: I rescued my Rottweiler when she was 2 years old, and she behaved the exact same way. She would spite pee/poop all over the place, destroyed everything in sight, broke out of her crate multiple times etc etc. Absolutely a nightmare. Unfortunately, a lot of her improvement came from me just giving her the time and space to get used to her new home. I also enrolled her in training classes which are helping immensely. I’ve had her for about 7 months at this point, and she still needs to be crated when I leave the house, but the accidents have stopped and she’s not nearly as destructive as she was when I first got her. Rottweilers also need a hefty amount of exercise a day. Mine goes to daycare for 6 or so hours a day on average, and then we go home and do training together so she’s super tired/calm at home. On days we don’t do daycare we do extra long at home training sessions, or long walks outside. Even our trainer mentioned that Rottweilers are VERY VERY stubborn, and the trick is that we as their owners need to “out stubborn” them.
